title: Prepending one step to guarded halting
statement: Let $A$ be a register program with oracle, let $x$ be an input, and let $G$ be a predicate on configurations. If $G$ holds of a configuration $a$ and the run starting from the one-step successor of $a$ halts with answer $r$ while satisfying $G$ at every configuration before halting, then the run starting from $a$ also halts with answer $r$ and satisfies $G$ at every configuration before halting.
hypotheses_covered: Guarded halting with answer $r$ from the one-step successor of $a$
